document_title: National Bank of Kazakhstan Resolution No. 231, 29 November 2019: Rules for cash operations (original published edition)
edition_note: Sections were verified against the original official publication. Current consolidated amendments could not be verified. Applicability requires human review.

rules.title: Possible departure during client service
rules.summary: A cashier may not leave the workplace before completing client service.
conditions: A client is visibly engaged in an unfinished cash transaction
The servicing cashier leaves the workstation while the client remains waiting
rules.exclusions: Sitting, reaching nearby equipment, another worker moving, a completed transaction, or a client departing are insufficient.

rules.title: Possible exposure of previously accepted cash
rules.summary: Previously accepted cash is held in locking storage devices at the cashier's workplace.
conditions: The sequence visibly establishes cash was accepted from an earlier client
That cash remains exposed outside locking storage after the earlier transaction and during another transaction or absence
rules.exclusions: Cash from the current client, counting in progress, uncertain ownership, or an unobservable lock state are insufficient.

rules.title: Possible customer absence during cash acceptance
rules.summary: Cash is accepted and counted in the client's presence.
conditions: A client visibly hands cash to the cashier for a deposit
The client leaves and the cashier only then starts accepting or counting that same cash
rules.exclusions: Internal preparation, a payout, another worker, a client outside the camera view, or uncertain transaction direction are insufficient.

rules.title: Possible omission of cash counting
rules.summary: A cashier accepts banknotes with note-by-note counting and coins with piece-by-piece counting.
conditions: A complete deposit transaction from receipt to completion is visible without gaps
The cashier stores the received cash and completes service without manual or machine counting
rules.exclusions: Missing beginning or end, counting outside the frame, pre-counted preparation, or a machine whose operation is unclear are insufficient.

rules.title: Possible diversion of accepted cash
rules.summary: Cash storage protects the funds; previously accepted cash belongs in locking storage devices.
conditions: Cash is visibly received from a client and stays traceable through the sequence
The cashier visibly moves that cash into a personal clothing pocket or personal bag
rules.exclusions: Moving a phone, document or own property, cash in an authorized transport container, or an occluded hand is insufficient. Do not assert theft or intent.

rules.title: Possible unsafe cash handling
rules.summary: Cash storage includes measures to safeguard the cash.
conditions: The objects are clearly identifiable as banknotes or coins and their movement is visible
A visible physical action damages the cash, leaves it unsecured on the floor or outside the controlled workspace, or allows its removal while the cashier is disengaged
rules.exclusions: Ordinary counting, authorized handover, a promptly corrected accidental drop, unclear objects, unrelated phone use, or unobservable authorization are insufficient. Do not infer theft, intent, a shortage, or legal guilt.
